integrity: The transform is proved by an exact marked-sequence count and the ordinary generating function of Stirling numbers of the second kind. The doubleton covariance is obtained by differentiating that same transform and its sign is proved by a positive harmonic-sum increment. An exhaustive finite sequence checker and exact rational algebra provide supplementary replay.
scientific_limitations: The transform assumes equally likely coupon types.
The originality claim starts at multiplicity r>=2 because the singleton/completion-time joint distribution is prior work.
The theorem gives one multiplicity coordinate at a time, not the full multivariate stopped occupancy spectrum.
title: Exact completion-time transform for coupon multiplicity counts
